snippet.title: Ramen-ten "Heart Abyss" — Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a cozy Asian noodle shop right from your desk. Discover new recipes, decorate your counter, and treat peasants, samurai, and yokai to delicious, hot food while you work or relax.
